source_route_reuse: Keep published macro_step/frame_axes boundary permutation. Use the declared inward-through-anchor two-tick spatial realization; this is not the unchanged published outward midpoint.

Then scatter according to the existing cyclic source-slot route and commit the order controller.
allowed_interpretation: sum-conserving integer load exchange and path transport; quadratic loss is a diagnostic of this selected operation

no physical total-energy conservation by an unnamed reservoir
not a viscosity or classical NS theorem

selection_provenance: The two controller permutations were selected by an explicit finite combinatorial pair-coverage search, not independent empirical validation. The loss-producing exchange operation is a stated constitutive choice.
